headline: 9 Solana program IDs catalogued from official docs and GitHub; Squads multisig admin confirmed but specific multisig address not surfaced; DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chain.

findings.text: D1: Solana block explorers (solscan.io, explorer.solana.com) are not in DeFiPunkd's supported chainId list and cannot be read via the read API. No EVM-chain deployments exist for this protocol. Solana explorer name-tag search was not attempted via direct fetch due to tool-call budget constraints; recorded in unknowns.

D2: Official deployed programs page found at https://docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/security.md. Lists 4 core programs (Exponent Core, CLMM, Orderbook, Strategy Vaults) and 5 interface programs (Generic, Kamino, marginfi, Jito Restaking, Perena) with their Solana program IDs. Set as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: Audit page at https://docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/audits-bug-bounty lists 25 audits from 6 firms (OtterSec, Offside Labs, Sec3, Certora, Accretion, Adevar Labs) covering exponent_core, exponent_clmm, exponent_orderbook, exponent_vault, exponent_tranching, generic_standard, kamino_lend_standard, marginfi_standard, jito_restaking_standard, perena_usd_standard. No in-scope contract addresses appear in the audit listing page itself (PDFs not fetched due to tool budget). Addresses are sourced from D2 docs page instead.

D4: GitHub org https://github.com/exponent-finance has 3 public repos: exponent-core (Rust, core programs), exponent-audits (audit PDFs), strategy-recipes (TypeScript). exponent-core README confirms Program ID ExponentnaRg3CQbW6dqQNZKXp7gtZ9DGMp1cwC4HAS7 with deployed commit hash 7011d1b46b542611543f8ed21836b165f2ab75ac. Anchor.toml confirms same core program ID plus localnet exponent_admin ID 3D6ojc8vBfDteLBDTTRznZbZRh7bkEGQaYqNkudoTCBQ (localnet only, not mainnet). No broadcast/run-latest.json or hardhat-deploy artifacts found — Anchor-based Solana project.
D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: No factory pattern identified in fetched sources. Exponent uses a market-creation model per the docs (yield markets per asset/duration), but no factory contract address or enumeration method surfaced from fetched pages. Recorded in unknowns.

D7: All 9 program IDs classified with role taxonomy. Admin control described as Squads multisig of core contributors per security docs, but specific Squads multisig address not surfaced. Solana program IDs cannot be placed in admin_addresses[].address (EVM-only schema field); recorded as unknowns with D8 code.

D8: All 9 program IDs trace to fetched docs URL (https://docs.exponent.finance/user-documentation/security.md). Squads multisig address cited in docs narrative but no specific address provided — cannot place in admin_addresses[]. Solana program IDs are base58 strings, incompatible with the 0x-prefixed address schema field; all Solana addresses omitted from admin_addresses[] address field to avoid schema validation failure.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked official website, docs (programs/security page, audits page), docs index (llms.txt), GitHub org (3 repos), exponent-core README, and Anchor.toml. 9 Solana program IDs catalogued from docs. Squads multisig governance confirmed in docs but no specific multisig address discovered. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana, so no on-chain reads were performed. grade=unknown because (a) Solana program IDs cannot populate the EVM-schema admin_addresses[].address field, (b) specific multisig address not surfaced, and (c) no on-chain reads possible.

D6: No factory contract address or market-enumeration method surfaced from fetched pages. Exponent creates yield markets per underlying asset/expiry; factory-pattern program address (if any) not identified.

D8: Squads multisig address (admin authority over all Exponent programs) mentioned in security docs narrative but no specific on-chain address provided. Next run should search Squads app or Solana explorer for Exponent multisig.

protocol_metadata.about: Exponent is Solana's yield exchange, enabling users to strip yield from yield-bearing assets into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), lock in fixed rates, trade interest rate derivatives, and provide liquidity to yield markets. Users can access fixed income by swapping floating-rate staking/lending yields for fixed returns over defined durations, or take leveraged yield positions. The protocol operates via four core programs (Core, CLMM, Orderbook, Strategy Vaults) plus per-integration interface programs, all governed by a Squads multisig of core contributors. The protocol has been live on Solana mainnet since 2024 with over $100M TVL and $2.5B+ in traded yield volume.
